narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms moved northwest through Southeastern Arizona the afternoon and evening of August 25th. These storms caused the formation of a dust storm that decreased visibilities to less than 0.25 miles, caused damage to utility equipment causing power outages for an estimated total of 1283 customers, and caused damage to a roof. Additionally, the heavy rainfall from the thunderstorms caused cars to be stranded along Frontage Road in Tucson due to flash flooding.
ev: Tohono Oodham Nation Dispatch reported water flooding the San Manual Road from mile post 1 to 24.
Social media video of cars stuck in flooded waters on frontage road along Interstate-10 north of Red Rock. A nearby rain gauge reported 1.83 inches of rainfall fell in 24 hours.
